status: Candidate reusable datasets and benchmarks. NOT cleared for release: every entry has open licensing/visibility questions listed below. Descriptions come from the producing track's files; H-001 checked row counts and field names, not values.
globalCaveats: VISIBILITY: indy-init-rehearsal-002..010, research-documents, causa-acceptance-r10 and Indy-init-audits are PRIVATE (REPOSITORY-ACCESS.json). Several datasets below are derived from them. The sprint directory lives in cohort-based-engineering, which is PUBLIC. Merging these derived datasets to a pushed branch publishes facts from private repositories (commit SHAs, file paths, defect descriptions, branch names). The owner should decide this before the Director pushes, independent of any later publication decision.

LICENSE: no LICENSE file in Indy-init, the rehearsal repositories, research-documents, cohort-based-engineering or causa-acceptance-r10 (checked R8, Indy-init, cohort-based-engineering, research-documents, causa-acceptance-r10). Praxis is PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Absence of a license means no reuse grant; derived-data reuse needs an explicit owner license choice.

MODEL IDENTIFIERS: MANIFEST.md states model identifiers are kept out of repository artifacts, but A's executions.csv, requests.csv and controlled-usage.csv carry a model column copied from source telemetry, and A's REPORT names the price-table entry. The Director should decide whether this is acceptable (it is source data, not the Director's identity).
THIRD-PARTY TERMS: GitHub Actions API data (A, B) is the account's own data; redistribution as a dataset is subject to GitHub terms and contains run IDs and branch names.

COST: every USD column is a list-price ESTIMATE from cohort-based-engineering research/pricing/anthropic.price-table.json tableVersion 2026-10-20.1. No provider bill exists. R3/R7 cache writes are priced at the 5m rate; R8 uses the 5m/1h split (V1: $193.74 vs $190.51 on a 5m-only basis).

datasets.name: Rehearsal failure-event corpus R1-R10 + Causa

schema.timestamp: ISO-8601 UTC or null (null when the source gives no time)
schema.description: free text written by the analyst

datasets.provenance: Curated by one analyst (B-001) from final reports, deviation logs and results docs at the revisions in B-forensics/data/revisions.tsv; every record cites a source line.
datasets.reproducibility: PARTIAL. Sources are pinned by SHA and line, so each record can be re-checked, but curation (which events, which root cause) is judgement; B's limitations note minor frictions are under-sampled. No second coder. B's scripts/tests (24 passing) cover aggregation, not curation.
datasets.licensingCaveats: Derived from private rehearsal repositories and private research-documents; descriptions quote defect detail. Not releasable without owner consent and redaction review.
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Candidate labelled corpus for 'agentic delivery failure taxonomy' work; needs inter-rater reliability (FX-08) before any external use.

datasets.name: Per-rehearsal outcome summary
datasets.schema: rehearsal, scope, plannedRequirements, completedRequirements, completedBasis, indyInitVerdict, selfReported, acceptedUnderIndyInit, firstGreenAppCiMin, firstGreenBuildWorkflowMin_actions, firstDeployedAppMin, firstVerifiedE2eMin, ciRunsWindow, ciFailuresWindow, ciCancelledWindow, governanceFailureEvents, contractIncompatibilityEvents, integrationFailureEvents, mergesInWindow, conflictedMerges_source, conflictedMerges_recordsOnly, humanInterventionEvents, topology, sources
datasets.provenance: Mixed: verdicts as recorded by each run; milestone minutes from reports or Actions; merge counts from git merge-tree replay.
datasets.reproducibility: PARTIAL. Units differ per row (completedBasis column says which); T0 definitions differ (B-F-10). Not a comparable series.
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Low as a benchmark (non-comparable rows). Useful as an index into the runs.

datasets.name: GitHub Actions runs/jobs/steps for Indy-init and R1-R10
datasets.producer: A-economics (runs, jobs, steps) and B-forensics (run lists), fetched independently
datasets.size: A: 4,633 runs, 6,013 jobs (timed-window runs only), 58,470 steps; B: 3,222 runs (R1-R10)
datasets.provenance: GitHub Actions REST API, GET only, fetched 2026-11-08 ~18:40-19:30Z (A, see ci-fetch-manifest.json); B fetched separately. 0 fetch errors reported by A. Causa's Actions API was unreachable (B gap); B-forensics/raw/actions/causa.jsonl.tmp is an incomplete partial file and should be excluded or removed.
datasets.reproducibility: HIGH for the snapshot (raw JSONL kept; scripts fetch_ci_runs.py, build_ci.py, fetch_ci_jobs.py, analyze_ci.py; 18 tests). Re-fetching will drift: runs can be deleted or expire (GitHub log retention), and runs after the fetch will appear. Two independent fetches (A and B) allow a cross-check that no one has run yet (FX-09).
datasets.licensingCaveats: Most repositories are private. Run IDs, branch names and step names reveal internal process. Public repositories are not billed, so 'billable minutes' is a compute proxy only (A-F-12).
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Good candidate for a 'CI cost of agentic delivery' dataset after redaction: real runs, step-level timing, labelled timed windows (rehearsal-windows.csv).

datasets.name: Praxis execution records and per-request token ledger
datasets.size: 626 execution records (14 repositories); 3,654 request rows (R8 + praxis); token totals for R3, R7, R8 only
datasets.schema: See A-economics/data/README.md (column-level). Empty cell = unavailable; 0 = recorded zero. Columns ending ESTIMATE or LOWERBOUND are not measured.
datasets.provenance: <repo>/.ros/telemetry/executions/*.json at the revisions in A data/README.md; rehearsal telemetry files for R3/R7/R8.
datasets.reproducibility: HIGH for totals: V1 independently recomputed R8 533,823,102 tokens and the coordinator share exactly (V1 A-F-01, A-F-03). V1 found 48 ledgers / 3,100 requests for R8 where A's README says 49 executions (totals unaffected). Category assignment in r8-workitem-categories.csv is judgement with a cited basis per row. wall_ms is not a reliable duration (A-F-10).
datasets.licensingCaveats: Source telemetry in private rehearsal repositories; includes session IDs, agent IDs and a model column (see globalCaveats MODEL IDENTIFIERS).
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Rare real-world multi-agent token dataset with cache buckets per request. Only one rehearsal (R8) has per-request detail, so it is a case study, not a benchmark.

datasets.name: Controlled pilot usage (CONSTRUCT-008, time-entry-expanded-01)
datasets.size: 21 run rows over 2 experiments: n=3 per arm, plus 3 CONSTRUCT-008 arm-C rows labelled C-P1..C-P3 (apparently preliminary runs; A-F-16 median 730k matches C1-C3 only, so they are excluded from the headline)
datasets.reproducibility: MEDIUM: output tokens are lower bounds (streaming start), with a chars/4 estimate alongside; arms differ in repair rounds (A-F-16 limitation).
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Pilot only; feeds FX-05 power analysis.

datasets.name: Echelon ecosystem dependency graph and pin-skew table

schema.edges: {from, to, type: package-ref|CLI-invocation|contract/schema|doc-only-claim, vias[], versions[], evidence[], count}

datasets.provenance: Static extraction by C-architecture/tools/archgraph.py and build_inventory.py over checked-out repositories and ext clones at the heads in source-revisions.tsv.
datasets.reproducibility: HIGH: tools/run.sh regenerates everything; 34 passing tests. Point-in-time: pins on main only (C-F-01 limitation).
datasets.licensingCaveats: Mostly public repositories plus private Indy-init-related ones; the graph itself reveals little sensitive detail. Praxis-derived facts are under PolyForm Noncommercial for the source, not for facts about it (owner should confirm).
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Good candidate for a public 'small-ecosystem version skew' case study; lowest release risk of the five.

datasets.name: Governance bypass matrix (Praxis 3.25.0 / Dokimos 0.11.1)
datasets.size: 17 gate-regression cases (E-X01) + 13 new cases (E-X02) + fabricated-acceptance run; 15 refused / 11 succeeded overall

schema.E-X01: {case, intent, mode, expected, outcome, exit, codes[], verifierKeyIds, evidence}
schema.E-X02: {case, attempt, expected, outcome, exit, codes[], detail, note}

datasets.provenance: Executed locally against tools built from source: praxis 12bf995 (3.25.0), dokimos fecbe0c (0.11.1), ordo sde db6d39e, Indy-init dae2347 (E findings.json tested_versions). Fixture repositories under /home/user/sprint-scratch/E/ (not preserved in the repository).
datasets.reproducibility: MEDIUM-HIGH: scripts are committed with 19 tests; fixtures are regenerated by the scripts, but the scratch fixtures themselves are not committed. Version-specific: results hold only for the listed revisions.
datasets.licensingCaveats: SECURITY SENSITIVE. Contains working bypass procedures against controls the owner relies on, several not yet fixed (E-F-02, E-F-03, E-F-04, E-F-05). Must not be published before fixes or an explicit disclosure decision. The secret-scan output (secret-scan-redacted.json) holds fingerprints only, by design.
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Strong candidate as a regression suite for Praxis release CI (E recommends this). As a public benchmark only after fixes ship.

datasets.name: Merge-conflict replay results
datasets.producer: B-forensics (merge-conflicts.json); V1 and A2 produce independent replays
datasets.size: every two-parent merge in R1-R10 and Causa (B); R8 86-87 merge commits
datasets.schema: per merge: repository, merge sha, parents, conflicted paths (see file)
datasets.provenance: git merge-tree replay with current git defaults (B-F-09 limitation: squash merges and rebases invisible; not the agents' tools).
datasets.reproducibility: HIGH for method, but three replays disagree on some per-run counts (matrix X-02, X-03). Window and ref-set definitions must be fixed before reuse.
datasets.licensingCaveats: Private rehearsal repositories; file paths only.
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Input fixture for the A2 merge-driver experiment and for any .ros format change (ADR-S02).

datasets.name: Curated UI/WASM defect patterns, R1-R10 + Causa
datasets.size: 29 curated defects in 11 patterns; 1,236 commit signal rows; 202 F# compiler diagnostics from 34 transcripts; 157 build invocations; 8 Limen claims
datasets.provenance: Hand-curated from commit messages, defect files and construction-by-design transcripts (F-F-08, F-F-17).
datasets.reproducibility: MEDIUM: sources cited per row; curation and pattern assignment are judgement, with selection bias toward well-described fixes (F-F-17 limitation).
datasets.licensingCaveats: Private rehearsal repositories and private research-documents transcripts.
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Seed set for UI-contract checks (13 of 29 need a new contract). The transcript-error set is a small but rare dataset of agent F# compile errors.

datasets.name: F# WASM build, bundle, startup and accessibility measurements
datasets.size: n=3-7 per condition; 22 axe scans; 6 bundle variants
datasets.schema: see files; environment.json records host, SDK and browser versions
datasets.provenance: Measured in this sprint on a shared 4 vCPU container (load average up to 14); 4G is CDP emulation.
datasets.reproducibility: MEDIUM: scripts committed, but timing is contended; loadavg samples are recorded so readers can judge. Byte sizes are reproducible; times are not portable.
datasets.licensingCaveats: Builds of private rehearsal apps; measurements only.
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Useful internal baseline for trimming and caching changes (IM-12). Not a public benchmark (single contended host).

datasets.name: .ros merge-driver replay over R8 and R10
datasets.size: 86 R8 and 34 R10 merges; v1 and v2 driver runs
datasets.schema: per merge: parents, conflicted paths under each config, driver exit, records lost/duplicated, equivalence to team merge (see files)
datasets.provenance: Replays in scratch clones (unshallowed after an invalid shallow run, disclosed in A2 CHECKPOINT); preregistered SPR-A2-01 with Amendment 1.
datasets.reproducibility: HIGH: tools and raw outputs committed; requires full (unshallow) clones of private R8/R10.
datasets.licensingCaveats: Private rehearsal repositories; file paths and work-item IDs.
datasets.benchmarkPotential: A ready regression fixture for any Praxis history-merge change (IM-10).

datasets.name: Pre-T0 dry-run replay results (11 blockers)
datasets.size: 11 blocker rows (R4, R8, R9, R10, Causa); B3/B4 add semantic-check rows on 4 packages
datasets.schema: rehearsal, blocker, preT0Commit, toolsRun, outcome (CAUGHT/NOT CAUGHT), matchEvidence, dryRunSeconds
datasets.provenance: Replays on T0-era commits of Indy-init and rehearsal repositories; preregistered protocols with deviation addenda.
datasets.reproducibility: HIGH for mechanics (clean rerun ~199 s); matching rules partly finalised after first runs (B2-F-01), and B3/B4 rules are answer-informed.
datasets.benchmarkPotential: Small labelled benchmark for 'governance artefact preflight' tools. Needs independent specifications to avoid overfitting (FX-14).

datasets.name: Build/test cost microbenchmarks and agent-arm usage
datasets.size: 6 runs per arm (D confirmatory), n=4 per arm (D2)
datasets.schema: see protocols; D2 usage is runtime-reported tokens per arm agent
datasets.provenance: Preregistered (D: protocols frozen before runs; D2: two-stage gates). Shared host contention recorded.
datasets.reproducibility: HIGH for D analysis (seeded bootstrap, tests); D2 depends on the Director's agent tool and model version.
datasets.licensingCaveats: D2 fixture is sprint-authored; D reanalysis inputs include public cohort-based-engineering and praxis experiment data.
datasets.benchmarkPotential: D2's fixture plus ceiling results are a useful negative-result package; D's protocols are a reusable template for build-cost experiments.
